'''Revis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and suffering from [[Kanju's disease]], he asked a Sith Empire-aligned individual to upload data from a [[Computer spike/Legends|spike]] to help with [[Project Hexapod]].<ref name="TOR" />
